findings.summary: CLOSED: cancel.check()? is now the first statement of Medium::seek, so a cancelled seek answers Cancelled in both routes of Keyframe and before any Exact work; test arq_139_the_keyframe_seek_checks_the_cancel_token.
OPEN, unchanged by the fix: the fraction steps by done/planned with planned = duration x fps; when the packet count differs the last report jumps and the 0.02 step bound breaks.
OPEN, unchanged: KeyframeIndex never sorts its times although the type documents them ascending and looks them up with partition_point.
OPEN: the implementer still owns the gafira-time line of the testkit ports feature, a single-writer file of SC1; the default graph is unchanged.
OPEN: ARQ-138 is proved in substance but no test names it; git grep reaches only a module header.
OPEN: ME1 is 1401 code lines, 2.0x the ~700 guide and 2.3x its adjusted forecast of 600; the owner's OK is still not recorded.
OPEN: XP6 (<=1 s per minute of 1080p) has no spike and the crate has no benches/ directory, so ARQ-144's FIJADA figure is unmeasured.
ARQ-44, a Product ID of the ME2 card, has no test in gafira-media that names it; the bytes()/trim acceptance is proved by two arq_145_ tests but the ID does not trace.
CAL-14 and FV-11 (b) are listed by the ME2 card without 'partial' and no test, bench or command proves them; CAL-14's <50 ms cache search is unmeasured (no benches/), FV-11 (b) needs ME4.
The ME2 Flow line still says verify: V2 and mutation: archive while O5 sets V1 from ME2 and O4 sets mutation: off; the block was written in 98e6d57 before those decisions and never amended.

ARQ-43 is a card Product ID and no test, bench or command names it; the per-frame checkpoint is proved under ARQ-146, but the <=100 ms bound needs bench_cancel_segment and gafira-media has no benches/.
AC21's second clause, the exported file has the original resolution, has no proof: only the reader half exists until the ME5 exporter. ARQ-146 and AC21 need the partial marker.
FV-22 is listed without a partial marker and only (b) is proved: the automatic trigger, the manual create/delete and (c) have no code or test in this delivery.

The 10 GB budget counts only the copies this process wrote: the store never seeds from the cache directory and never drops *.part files, so an earlier session can exceed the limit; open+seek(End) would size them.
ME3 is 1108 code lines (1163 with the notes): 1.58x the ~700 guide and 1.7x its adjusted forecast, so it needs the owner's explicit OK.
